name: tool-calling-vi-full
description: Full benchmark on 1,600 CustomTools-VI samples (800 seen + 800 unseen)
definition:
@kbench.task(name="tool-calling-vi-full", description="Full benchmark on 1,600 CustomTools-VI samples (800 seen + 800 unseen)")
def tool_calling_vi_full(llm) -> dict:
    seen_samples = load_jsonl_samples("test_seen.jsonl", SEEN_DATA_B64)
    unseen_samples = load_jsonl_samples("test_unseen.jsonl", UNSEEN_DATA_B64)

    # Push guard: Kaggle auto-runs default model (3.7) upon push.
    # Keep push verification fast and cheap (5 samples only).
    is_push_verification = "3.7" in str(llm.model)
    if is_push_verification:
        seen_samples = seen_samples[:3]
        unseen_samples = unseen_samples[:2]

    total_samples = len(seen_samples) + len(unseen_samples)
    print(f"Running evaluation on {len(seen_samples)} seen + {len(unseen_samples)} unseen samples (Total: {total_samples})...")

    # Evaluate using ThreadPoolExecutor for high throughput
    def run_eval_batch(samples):
        results = []
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as executor:
            future_to_item = {executor.submit(evaluate_single_sample, llm, item): item for item in samples}
            for future in as_completed(future_to_item):
                results.append(future.result())
        return results

    seen_results = run_eval_batch(seen_samples)
    unseen_results = run_eval_batch(unseen_samples)

    # Seen metrics
    seen_total = len(seen_results)
    seen_tool_correct = sum(1 for r in seen_results if r["tool_correct"])
    seen_exact_match = sum(1 for r in seen_results if r["exact_match"])
    seen_latencies = [r["latency_ms"] for r in seen_results if r["latency_ms"] > 0]
    seen_tool_acc = round(seen_tool_correct / seen_total * 100, 2) if seen_total else 0.0
    seen_arg_acc = round(seen_exact_match / seen_total * 100, 2) if seen_total else 0.0
    seen_avg_lat = round(sum(seen_latencies) / len(seen_latencies), 1) if seen_latencies else 0.0

    # Unseen metrics
    unseen_total = len(unseen_results)
    unseen_tool_correct = sum(1 for r in unseen_results if r["tool_correct"])
    unseen_exact_match = sum(1 for r in unseen_results if r["exact_match"])
    unseen_latencies = [r["latency_ms"] for r in unseen_results if r["latency_ms"] > 0]
    unseen_tool_acc = round(unseen_tool_correct / unseen_total * 100, 2) if unseen_total else 0.0
    unseen_arg_acc = round(unseen_exact_match / unseen_total * 100, 2) if unseen_total else 0.0
    unseen_avg_lat = round(sum(unseen_latencies) / len(unseen_latencies), 1) if unseen_latencies else 0.0

    # Overall metrics
    overall_total = seen_total + unseen_total
    overall_tool_correct = seen_tool_correct + unseen_tool_correct
    overall_exact_match = seen_exact_match + unseen_exact_match
    all_latencies = seen_latencies + unseen_latencies
    overall_tool_acc = round(overall_tool_correct / overall_total * 100, 2) if overall_total else 0.0
    overall_arg_acc = round(overall_exact_match / overall_total * 100, 2) if overall_total else 0.0
    overall_avg_lat = round(sum(all_latencies) / len(all_latencies), 1) if all_latencies else 0.0

    print(f"=== EVALUATION COMPLETE FOR {llm.model} ===")
    print(f"  [Seen]   Tool Acc: {seen_tool_acc}% | ArgA/EM: {seen_arg_acc}% | Latency: {seen_avg_lat} ms")
    print(f"  [Unseen] Tool Acc: {unseen_tool_acc}% | ArgA/EM: {unseen_arg_acc}% | Latency: {unseen_avg_lat} ms")
    print(f"  [Overall] Tool Acc: {overall_tool_acc}% | ArgA/EM: {overall_arg_acc}% | Latency: {overall_avg_lat} ms")

    kbench.assertions.assert_true(
        overall_tool_acc >= 50.0,
        expectation=f"Overall tool accuracy should be >= 50%, got {overall_tool_acc}%"
    )

    return {
        "model": llm.model,
        "total_samples": overall_total,
        "seen_samples": seen_total,
        "seen_tool_accuracy_pct": seen_tool_acc,
        "seen_arga_exact_match_pct": seen_arg_acc,
        "seen_avg_latency_ms": seen_avg_lat,
        "unseen_samples": unseen_total,
        "unseen_tool_accuracy_pct": unseen_tool_acc,
        "unseen_arga_exact_match_pct": unseen_arg_acc,
        "unseen_avg_latency_ms": unseen_avg_lat,
        "overall_tool_accuracy_pct": overall_tool_acc,
        "overall_arga_exact_match_pct": overall_arg_acc,
        "overall_avg_latency_ms": overall_avg_lat,
        "details_seen_sample_count": len(seen_results),
        "details_unseen_sample_count": len(unseen_results)
    }
